title: Suggest new domain vocabulary without making it a gate

steps.action: Compare code that adds a new named domain declaration plus an unrelated constant.
steps.expected_result: Only the domain declaration is suggested as optional vocabulary growth.

steps.action: Record a term that names the suggested declaration.
Compare a rename of a declaration already named by a term.
steps.expected_result: The existing term becomes stale and no duplicate new-term suggestion appears.

expected_result: Only genuinely new named domain declarations are suggested, and recording or renaming known vocabulary removes the suggestion.
